words.name: Hold the wall
words.blurb: Walls: culture 5 and a fort, and walled land that touches defends together.
words.opening: Larkfell and Westermore each have a fort and culture 4, and a Captain's army waits in Thornton next door. One more level of culture on each, and the two become a wall.
words.goal: Wall Larkfell and Westermore, and still hold both at the start of turn 4.
words.met: Larkfell and Westermore are walled and still yours
hints: Raise culture to 5 on Larkfell and on Westermore (10 gold each). With their forts, both are walled at the end of the turn.
Walled land that touches is one wall: attack one part, and every other part lends its spare troops to the defence.
Each other territory in a wall adds 10% to its defence. Troops behind a wall make it less worth attacking.
words.closing: A wall's real work is the attacks it puts off, and the ones it survives. Next: the cards.
